apptoken.label: Cider API token
apptoken.description: From Cider → Settings → Connectivity → External Application Access (apptoken header). Leave empty to reuse ~/.config/cider-kde-notifier/config.json.

display_mode.label: Track alert style
display_mode.description: Noctalia notification (recommended), rich OSD panel, or silent on track changes.

save_to_history.label: Save track alerts to history
save_to_history.description: When using notifications, also keep them in notification history. Off by default.

osd_duration_ms.label: Alert duration (ms)
osd_duration_ms.description: How long the notification or now-playing OSD stays visible after a track change.

lyrics_osd_enabled.label: Enable lyrics HUD
lyrics_osd_enabled.description: Bar widget click toggles sticky lyrics. Off = click does nothing.

lyrics_osd_position.label: Lyrics HUD position
lyrics_osd_position.description: Where the overlay sits on screen. Reopen the HUD after changing.

lyrics_osd_show_next.label: Show next line
lyrics_osd_show_next.description: Dim preview of the upcoming lyric under the current line.

lyrics_osd_animate_cues.label: Animate cue dots
lyrics_osd_animate_cues.description: Pulse three cue dots through intros, interludes, and song mixes. Off = static dots.

lyrics_osd_karaoke.label: Word sing-along highlight
lyrics_osd_karaoke.description: Highlight the currently sung word when Apple syllable timings exist. Line-only lyrics light the whole active line to match Cider.

lyrics_osd_glow.label: Lyric drop shadow
lyrics_osd_glow.description: Offset dark shadow under overlay glyphs so they stay readable on wallpaper.

lyrics_karaoke_style.label: Karaoke colors
lyrics_karaoke_style.description: Theme follows the live Noctalia palette (on_surface + primary). Custom uses the hex fields below.

lyrics_karaoke_sung.label: Sung word color
lyrics_karaoke_sung.description: Hex for already-sung words when Karaoke colors is Custom. Empty keeps the theme color. Example: #f2f3f3

lyrics_karaoke_active.label: Active word color
lyrics_karaoke_active.description: Hex for the word currently being sung when Custom. Empty keeps Noctalia primary. Example: #83c2c8

lyrics_karaoke_upcoming.label: Upcoming word color
lyrics_karaoke_upcoming.description: Hex for not-yet-sung words in the current line when Custom. Empty uses sung color at lower opacity.

lyrics_osd_show_idle.label: Show idle placeholder
lyrics_osd_show_idle.description: When the HUD is open with no lyrics yet, show a muted music/idle message instead of a blank overlay.

show_cover.label: Show cover
show_cover.description: Show the current Cider artwork on the bar chip when a local cover file is available.

cover_size.label: Cover size
cover_size.description: Artwork edge length on the bar chip, in logical pixels (12–32).
